import sys, os, json, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

r=Robot()
Q=np.array([0.,1.,0.,0.])
def p(x,y,z): return [float(x),float(y),float(z),*Q]
def submit_rows(rows,note,dt=.5):
    a=r.submit('ee_pose',np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32),dt=dt,video='none',cameras=['canvas_cam'],note=note)
    print(note,len(rows),a.meta.get('control_steps_chunk'),a.meta.get('executed_rows'),a.meta.get('stopped'),a.group('tcp_pose',now=True)[:3],flush=True)
    if a.stopped or a.meta.get('executed_rows',len(rows))<len(rows): raise RuntimeError('partial call')
    return a

def travel(x,y,z=.06):
    submit_rows([p(x,y,z),p(x,y,z)],'travel')

def dip(i):
    xs=[-.16,-.13,-.10,-.07,-.04]
    # Palette is in two rows. Wells 1..5 at near row, 6..10 at far row.
    x=xs[(i-1)%5]; y=.145 if i<=5 else .17
    submit_rows([p(x,y,.06),p(x,y,.021),p(x,y,.021),p(x,y,.06)],f'dip{i:02d}',dt=.3)

def base():
    dip(1)
    xmin,xmax=-.2095,.0095
    ys=np.linspace(.1095,-.1095,21)
    rows=[p(xmin,ys[0],.06),p(xmin,ys[0],.008),p(xmin,ys[0],.008)]
    for i,y in enumerate(ys):
        end=xmax if i%2==0 else xmin
        rows.append(p(end,y,.008))
        if i+1<len(ys): rows.append(p(end,ys[i+1],.008))
    rows += [p(end,ys[-1],.008),p(end,ys[-1],.06)]
    # Limit total call duration, allowing at least one second per full traverse.
    for k in range(0,len(rows),7): submit_rows(rows[k:k+7],f'base_{k//7:02d}')
    travel(-.16,.145,.07)
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam'],video='none');Image.fromarray(o.last['canvas_cam']).save('/app/output/base.jpg')

if __name__=='__main__':
    base();print('STATUS',r.status(),flush=True)

a=rgb2lab(gaussian_filter(orig,(.65,.65,0)));p=rgb2lab(pal);labels=((a[...,None,:]-p)**2).sum(-1).argmin(-1).astype(np.int8);labels[np.min(orig,axis=2)>240]=-1

  for u0,u1 in zip(starts,ends):

print('runs',len(rows),{c:sum(x['c']==c for x in rows) for c in range(1,10)})
# link adjacent row runs when their side endpoints are close. Build paths greedily within color.
paths=[]
for c in range(1,10):
 rr=[x for x in rows if x['c']==c]
 byv={v:[j for j,x in enumerate(rr) if x['v']==v] for v in range(2,256,5)}

    else:path.extend([(q['b'],q['v']),(q['a'],q['v'])]);endpoint=q['a'];nextside=0
